description.value: Palagio Pizza is a late-night pizza and poutine destination on Douglas Street in Victoria, with a menu of handmade-dough pizzas and a dedicated '420 Poutine House' sub-brand offering creative poutine variations. The kitchen prides itself on daily-made dough and a house tomato sauce locals reportedly rave about. With gluten-free and non-dairy options available, it caters to a range of dietary needs and keeps unusually late hours well suited to tired cyclists rolling in after dark.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and confirms the business is a real, operating pizza and poutine fast-food restaurant in Victoria. The contact page confirms the phone (+1 250-655-5555), address (2950 Douglas St #165, Victoria, BC V8T 4N4), and website, all consistent with OSM. Gluten-free and non-dairy options are explicitly stated on the website; takeout is confirmed by the walk-in specials and online ordering prompts. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging is present anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM address field is empty; full address (2950 Douglas St #165, Victoria, BC V8T 4N4) was sourced from the website contact page.
Website contact page lists URL as https://palagio.ca (no www) while OSM has https://www.palagio.ca/ — functionally the same site but minor discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating fast-food pizza restaurant with a confirmed address and active website. Late-night hours and walk-in specials make it a practical stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Gluten Free & Non Dairy Options Available'; menu includes dedicated vegetarian pizzas (Vegi, Loaded vegetarian, Mediterranean, Popeye) and non-dairy cheese option for poutine
